source: Mubasher (english.mubasher.info) EGX financial statements, annual period
source_note: Read from the Mubasher English-language EGX statement page (english.mubasher.info), annual section (the source page labels the annual section "annual budget"). Mubasher prints that annual section in EGP thousand while the same page's quarterly sections print the same figures 1000 times larger, so the annual figures are multiplied by 1000 here and stored in absolute EGP, matching the unit used by every other statement file in this dataset. Unit established per company by comparing the annual section against the same page's quarterly sections; cross-checked against an independent provider (StockAnalysis absolute revenue for the same issuer) in the same order of magnitude. Total Assets less Total Liabilities equals Total Equity for every period listed.
_unitNote: source page annual section is EGP thousand; stored absolute EGP (x1000)
